column1: # The ten steps of the v3.2 §8 commissioning pipeline, and what answers each.
# answered-by: `rows` means commissioning.tsv rows carry this step number and
# the report names the step when no row does; `engine` means a mechanism that
# is not a row answers it (and which); `none` means nothing built answers it,
# and the report says so on every run. This file enumerates the moment from
# the architecture, not from what happened to be built, so a step nobody
# wrote a row for is a printed gap rather than a silence.

column2: determine maturity and the minimum declared risk envelope
raw repository reconnaissance with read-only instruments (felix_detect at felix new)
build a provenance-carrying project projection (facts.log, felix probes)
compile baseline engineering coverage from content providers
inventory existing skills, plugins, MCP servers, hooks, CI and toolchain
resolve and safely acquire missing capabilities
install or derive grounded probes and deterministic relations
emit the project_commissioned receipt bound to topology and toolchain (state/commission)
